verdict.rationale: EFTPS documents a Batch Provider program with free Batch Provider Software that lets tax professionals pay for multiple clients under a single login. That is one of the channel types the story names. However, the evidence is only a one-line mention: no specifications or file formats are shown, and the only published enrollment path is the generic EFTPS/customer-service one, not a batch-provider enrollment. Probes found no OpenAPI or other programmatic interface. Missing for 10: documented batch/transmitter specifications, a published enrollment path specific to batch providers or system accounts, a direct API, and independent corroboration that the channel works system-to-system.
